messages.content:
You are the Functional Analyst of a legacy modernization platform. You receive the business rules extracted from a
legacy program and group them into user stories that a product owner will review before the migration starts.

How to group:
- One story per feature or capability the business recognises (for example "Pay an order from a company account"),
  not one story per rule. A story usually links two to six rules.
- Every rule must be linked to at least one story. Do not invent behaviour that is not in the rules.

Each story has:
- `feature`: the capability it belongs to.
- `title`: short, in business language.
- `narrative`: "As a <role>, I want <goal>, so that <benefit>."
- `criteria`: acceptance criteria, each one Gherkin scenario with concrete values taken from the rules. Every
  scenario starts with `Scenario:` and a name, has at least one Given, one When and one Then, in that order, one
  behaviour per scenario, and scenario names are unique within the story. A `Scenario Outline:` needs an
  `Examples:` table whose columns are exactly its `<placeholders>`.
- `links`: the ids of the rules it covers (RULE-001...).
- `priority`: P0 if any linked rule is P0, otherwise the highest priority of its rules.
- `estimate`: relative size from 1 to 13.

Answer with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"stories": [{"feature": "...", "title": "...", "narrative": "As a ..., I want ..., so that ...",
  "criteria": ["Scenario: ...\n  Given ...\n  When ...\n  Then ..."], "links": ["RULE-001"], "priority": "P0",
  "estimate": 3}]}

Business rules:
[
 {
  "id": "RULE-001",
  "name": "Base commission: flat fee up to 1000, otherwise 0.1% of amount",
  "category": "calculation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "Operations of 1000.00 or less pay a flat commission of 0.50. Operations above 1000.00 pay 0.1% of the amount, rounded to 2 decimals with midpoints rounded away from zero.",
  "condition": "monto <= 1000 -> flat fee; monto > 1000 -> percentage fee",
  "action": "If monto <= 1000.00, comision = 0.50. Otherwise comision = Round(monto * 0.001, 2, AwayFromZero).",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Amount at the flat-fee limit\n  Given monto is 1000.00\n  When the commission is calculated\n  Then the base commission is 0.50",
   "Scenario: Amount above the limit\n  Given monto is 2500.00\n  When the commission is calculated\n  Then the base commission is 2.50",
   "Scenario: Midpoint rounding\n  Given monto is 1500.50\n  When the commission is calculated\n  Then 1500.50 * 0.001 = 1.5005 is rounded to 1.50",
   "Scenario: Just above the limit\n  Given monto is 1000.01\n  When the commission is calculated\n  Then the base commission is 1.00"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-002",
  "name": "Commission cap of 5.00 before surcharge",
  "category": "policy",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "If the calculated commission (comision) exceeds 5.00, it is set to 5.00.",
  "condition": "comision > 5.00",
  "action": "Set comision = 5.00.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Commission above the cap\n  Given monto is 20000.00 and the base commission is 20.00\n  When the cap is applied\n  Then the commission is 5.00",
   "Scenario: Commission exactly at the cap\n  Given monto is 5000.00 and the base commission is 5.00\n  When the cap is applied\n  Then the commission stays 5.00",
   "Scenario: Commission below the cap\n  Given monto is 3000.00 and the base commission is 3.00\n  When the cap is applied\n  Then the commission stays 3.00"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-003",
  "name": "Surcharge of 1.00 for type INM, applied after the cap",
  "category": "calculation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "Operations of type \"INM\" pay an extra 1.00 on top of the capped commission. The surcharge is not subject to the 5.00 cap, so an INM operation can pay up to 6.00.",
  "condition": "tipo == \"INM\" (exact, case-sensitive match)",
  "action": "comision = comision + 1.00, after the cap has been applied. The result is returned.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: INM operation with small amount\n  Given monto is 500.00 and tipo is \"INM\"\n  When the commission is calculated\n  Then the commission is 1.50",
   "Scenario: INM operation above the cap\n  Given monto is 10000.00 and tipo is \"INM\"\n  When the commission is calculated\n  Then the capped commission 5.00 plus 1.00 gives 6.00",
   "Scenario: Other type\n  Given monto is 500.00 and tipo is \"XYZ\"\n  When the commission is calculated\n  Then the commission is 0.50"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-004",
  "name": "Transfer receipt shows the stored amount, blank if the transfer does not exist",
  "category": "policy",
  "priority": "P2",
  "statement": "The transfer receipt page looks up the transfer by the number given in the request and shows that number together with the stored amount, formatted with two decimals. If no transfer has that number, the amount is left blank and no error is shown.",
  "condition": "A TRANSFERENCIAS row exists with TRF_NUMERO = requested number (amount shown); no such row exists (amount blank).",
  "action": "Set the number label to the requested number. Set the amount label to TRF_MONTO formatted as \"0.00\" when the row is found, or to an empty string when it is not.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Existing transfer\n Given transfer 1001 exists with TRF_MONTO 2500.5\n When the receipt page is opened with numero=1001\n Then the number label shows \"1001\"\n And the amount label shows \"2500.50\"",
   "Scenario: Unknown transfer\n Given no transfer with number 9999 exists\n When the receipt page is opened with numero=9999\n Then the number label shows \"9999\"\n And the amount label is empty"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-005",
  "name": "Origin and destination accounts must differ",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "A transfer cannot be made to the same account it is debited from. If origen == destino, the handler sets lblMensaje.Text to 'LA CUENTA DESTINO ES LA MISMA' and returns immediately, skipping the rest of the method.",
  "condition": "origen == destino (after trimming whitespace)",
  "action": "Reject the transfer with message 'LA CUENTA DESTINO ES LA MISMA' and stop; no database access occurs.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Same account\n Given origin account '1001' and destination account '1001'\n When the user requests a transfer\n Then the message 'LA CUENTA DESTINO ES LA MISMA' is shown and nothing is processed"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-006",
  "name": "Origin account must exist and be active",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "The debited account must exist in CUENTAS and have status 'A' (active). Otherwise the transfer is rejected and the transaction rolled back.",
  "condition": "No CUENTAS row for CTA_NUMERO = origen, or CTA_ESTADO != 'A'",
  "action": "Rollback; message 'CUENTA ORIGEN NO EXISTE' if absent, 'CUENTA ORIGEN INACTIVA' if status is not 'A'.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Origin account does not exist\n Given no account '9999' in CUENTAS\n When a transfer is requested from '9999'\n Then 'CUENTA ORIGEN NO EXISTE' is shown and the transaction is rolled back",
   "Scenario: Origin account inactive\n Given account '1001' with status 'B'\n When a transfer is requested from '1001'\n Then 'CUENTA ORIGEN INACTIVA' is shown and the transaction is rolled back"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-007",
  "name": "Destination account must exist and be active",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "The credited account must exist and be active ('A'). A missing or inactive destination is reported as 'CUENTA DESTINO NO EXISTE'.",
  "condition": "COUNT(*) of CUENTAS where CTA_NUMERO = destino and CTA_ESTADO = 'A' equals 0",
  "action": "Rollback and show 'CUENTA DESTINO NO EXISTE'.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Destination inactive or missing\n Given destination '2002' is not active or does not exist\n When a transfer is requested\n Then 'CUENTA DESTINO NO EXISTE' is shown and the transaction is rolled back"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-008",
  "name": "Sufficient balance to cover amount plus commission",
  "category": "validation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "The origin account balance must be at least the transfer amount plus the commission calculated for the transfer type; otherwise the transfer is refused with 'SALDO INSUFICIENTE'.",
  "condition": "saldo < monto + comision, where comision = ComisionService.Calcular(monto, tipo)",
  "action": "Rollback and show 'SALDO INSUFICIENTE'.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Balance does not cover commission\n Given origin balance 100.00, amount 100.00 and commission 1.50\n When the transfer is requested\n Then 'SALDO INSUFICIENTE' is shown and nothing is debited",
   "Scenario: Balance exactly covers\n Given origin balance 101.50, amount 100.00 and commission 1.50\n When the transfer is requested\n Then the balance check passes"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-009",
  "name": "Transfer posting: debit amount plus commission, credit amount only",
  "category": "calculation",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "The origin account is debited the amount plus the commission, while the destination is credited only the amount. The commission is retained by the bank and is not credited to any account in this code.",
  "condition": "All validations pass",
  "action": "origin CTA_SALDO = CTA_SALDO - (monto + comision); destination CTA_SALDO = CTA_SALDO + monto.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: Successful transfer\n Given origin balance 500.00, destination balance 50.00, amount 100.00 and commission 2.00\n When the transfer is executed\n Then the origin balance is 398.00 and the destination balance is 150.00"
  ]
 },
 {
  "id": "RULE-010",
  "name": "Transfer registration with sequential number and atomic commit",
  "category": "lifecycle",
  "priority": "P0",
  "statement": "Each completed transfer is recorded in TRANSFERENCIAS with number = ISNULL(MAX(TRF_NUMERO),0)+1 (starting at 1), with origin, destination, amount, commission and type, inserted within the same transaction (tx) and then committed. After the commit the code sets the commission label (format 0.00) and the message 'TRANSFERENCIA REALIZADA', then immediately redirects to Comprobante.aspx?numero=<numero>, so those labels are not actually shown on the page.",
  "condition": "Debit and credit executed",
  "action": "numero = ISNULL(MAX(TRF_NUMERO),0)+1; insert record with origin, destination, amount, commission, type; commit; show commission with 2 decimals and the message 'TRANSFERENCIA REALIZADA'; redirect to Comprobante.aspx?numero=numero.",
  "scenarios": [
   "Scenario: First transfer\n Given TRANSFERENCIAS is empty\n When a transfer completes\n Then it is recorded with TRF_NUMERO 1 and the user is redirected to Comprobante.aspx?numero=1"
  ]
 }
]

"criteria": [
"Scenario: Flat fee at the limit

"links": ["RULE-001", "RULE-002", "RULE-003"],
"priority": "P0",

{

"title": "Validate origin and destination accounts before a transfer",
"narrative": "As a bank customer, I want the transfer to be refused when the accounts are not valid, so that money is never moved to or from the wrong account.",
"criteria": [

  Given origin account '1001' and destination account '1001'
  When the user requests a transfer

},
{
"feature": "Account transfer",

"narrative": "As a bank customer, I want my transfer to be checked against my balance, posted with its commission and registered with a number, so that the money moves correctly and I can get a receipt.",
"criteria": [
"Scenario: Balance does not cover amount plus commission
  Given origin balance 100.00, amount 100.00 and commission 1.50
  When the transfer is requested
  Then 'SALDO INSUFICIENTE' is shown
  And nothing is debited",
"Scenario: Balance exactly covers amount plus commission
  Given origin balance 101.50, amount 100.00 and commission 1.50
  When the transfer is requested

  Given origin balance 500.00, destination balance 50.00, amount 100.00 and commission 2.00
  When the transfer is executed

  And the destination balance is 150.00",
"Scenario: First transfer is registered with number 1
  Given TRANSFERENCIAS is empty
  When a transfer completes

"Scenario: User is redirected to the receipt
  Given a transfer has been committed with TRF_NUMERO 1
  When the processing finishes
  Then the user is redirected to Comprobante.aspx?numero=1"
],
"links": ["RULE-008", "RULE-009", "RULE-010"],
"priority": "P0",
"estimate": 8
},
{
"feature": "Transfer receipt",
"title": "View the receipt of a transfer",
"narrative": "As a bank customer, I want to open the receipt of a transfer by its number, so that I can see the amount that was transferred.",
"criteria": [
"Scenario: Existing transfer
  Given transfer 1001 exists with TRF_MONTO 2500.5

"Scenario: Unknown transfer
